name: imap-mcp
description: Connects any IMAP mailbox — iCloud, Gmail, Outlook, Fastmail, university or company mail — to your second brain. Read-only against the mailbox.

account.title: Email address
account.description: The address you sign in with. This is your IMAP username.

provider.title: Mail provider
provider.description: icloud, gmail, outlook, fastmail, or generic.

imap_host.title: IMAP host (generic only)
imap_host.description: Only needed when provider is generic, e.g. mail.your-university.edu

vault_root.title: Vault folder
vault_root.description: Where synced mail is written as notes.
